offering_description.value: Provides cloud computing infrastructure and developer tools that let developers, startups and small and midsize businesses deploy, run and scale applications. Customers pay for virtual servers, managed services and storage on a pay-as-you-go or committed basis, delivered from company-operated data centers.

primary_products.value: virtual servers; managed Kubernetes; managed databases; object storage; load balancers

primary_services.value: application hosting platform; managed database operations; AI model inference infrastructure; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: developers, startups, software companies, small and midsize businesses

end_markets.value: software development; internet and digital media; e-commerce; artificial intelligence; technology startups

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered charges for compute, storage and bandwidth usage; subscription: monthly or committed-use plans for cloud services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells hosting and cloud infrastructure services to developers and businesses; software / platform: sells a developer cloud platform and management tools to businesses; asset operator: owns and operates data centers that run customer workloads
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: data centers in North America, Europe, Asia and other regions, customers worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: virtual servers, Kubernetes, managed databases, object storage and AI infrastructure, sold to the same developer customers

distribution_channels.value: online: self-serve web console and application programming interfaces; direct sales: sales team for larger business accounts; partners / resellers: channel and marketplace partners that resell or integrate its services

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and protection rules such as GDPR, plus export controls on hosted services
